Extreme Wide Shot.purpose: Shows a very large environment and places the subject within it.

Wide Shot.purpose: Shows the subject and surrounding environment.

Medium Shot.purpose: Shows the character roughly from the waist up.

Medium Close-Up.purpose: Frames the character from the chest or shoulders upward.

Close-Up.purpose: Focuses closely on a character's face or an important object.

Extreme Close-Up.purpose: Shows a very small detail such as an eye, hand, or object.

Over-the-Shoulder Shot.purpose: Shows the subject from behind another character's shoulder.

Point-of-View Shot.purpose: Shows what a character appears to see.

Eye-level.purpose: Shows the subject from a neutral perspective.

High Angle.purpose: Camera looks down toward the subject.
High Angle.use: Can communicate vulnerability, weakness, or isolation.

Low Angle.purpose: Camera looks upward toward the subject.
Low Angle.use: Can communicate power, dominance, or importance.

Dutch Angle.purpose: Camera is tilted away from the horizontal axis.

Pan.purpose: Camera rotates horizontally from a fixed position.

Tilt.purpose: Camera rotates vertically from a fixed position.

Tracking.purpose: Camera physically moves with or toward the subject.
